body.name: Ordinary full-kernel \(Q[S]\) query subclass \(\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\)
body.construction:
\(\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\) is the finite-rational, finite-discrete ordinary full-kernel class
\[
 \left\{(G,S_0,(\kappa_v)_{v\in V}):
 G\text{ is a finite semi-Markovian ADMG},\ 
 \varnothing\ne S_0\subseteq V,\ 
 \kappa_v\in\mathbb Q_{\ge0},\
 \text{ and the target is the complete kernel }
 Q[S_0]=\left\{P_{\operatorname{do}(V\setminus S_0=x)}(S_0=s):
 x\in\mathfrak X_{V\setminus S_0},\ s\in\mathfrak X_{S_0}\right\}
 \right\}.
\]
All intervention-assignment and outcome cells belong to the target; this is not a fixed-cell design problem.
